## Cyrena.Components.Runtime

**Project Type**: Blazor Library  
**Target Framework**: .NET 10.0  
**Namespace**: `Cyrena`  
**Version**: 0.6.0

### Purpose
Provides runtime UI components and services for the Cyréna AI assistant framework. This library contains the main chat interface, toolbar components, file upload handling, and kernel-scoped services that manage docking, file processing, and view provisioning.

### Folder Structure

| Folder | Contents |
|--------|----------|
| `Attributes` | Empty (attributes defined in Cyrena.Components.Core) |
| `Contracts` | Empty (contracts defined in Cyrena.Components.Core and Cyrena.Core) |

| `Models` | Empty (models defined in Cyrena.Components.Core and Cyrena.Core) |
| `Options` | Empty (options defined in Cyrena.Components.Core) |
| `Services` | Service implementations: ComponentAssistantsPlugin, DockingService, PdfFileHandler, ViewStartProvider |
| `Components/Shared` | Blazor components: Chat.razor, ChatToolbar.razor, FileUpload.razor |
| `wwwroot/css` | `chat.css` - Chat bubble and composer styling |
| `wwwroot/js` | Empty (no JavaScript files currently) |

### Shared Components (3)

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `Chat.razor` | Main chat UI with streaming, markdown rendering, file paste/drop support |
| `ChatToolbar.razor` | Dynamic toolbar that renders registered IToolbarComponent instances |
| `FileUpload.razor` | File attachment button with hidden InputFile for drag-and-drop |

### Services (4)

| Service | Contract | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| `ComponentAssistantsPlugin` | `IAssistantPlugin` | Plugin that registers toolbar components and file handlers per-kernel |
| `DockingService` | `IDockingService` | Manages docked panel requests via EventPipeline |
| `PdfFileHandler` | `IFileHandler` | Extracts text from PDF files using PdfPig |
| `ViewStartProvider` | `IViewStartProvider` | Provides default starting view entry |

### Extension Methods

| Extension | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `CyrenaBuilder.AddComponents()` | Registers MudBlazor services, ComponentAssistantsPlugin, and ViewStartProvider |

### Dependencies
- `Cyrena.Components.Core` - UI contracts, base classes, shared components

- `MudBlazor` - UI component library
- `Markdig` - Markdown rendering
- `PdfPig` - PDF text extraction
- `Microsoft.SemanticKernel` - Kernel integration
